notes: Seven own pages read in pass 1, all HTTP 200 and not thin: home, pricing (easier-pricing), cloud PMS, integrations hub, front desk, company and the own blog post on independent boutique hotel PMS cited by twelve answers. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. The pricing page shows two integration counts in its plan columns (1,400+ and 1,100+); the home and cloud PMS pages say 1400, so C04 is true. Mobile and tablet were split: C07 (mobile) is true; C09 (iPad) is unverifiable; answers that say tablets or mobile devices carry both C07 and C08. Lines that only recommend Stayntouch for mobile-first operations, awards (TravelTech Breakthrough), uptime, the 96 percent retention rate, room-count and group-size targets, ratings and the product heading StayNTouch Cloud PMS (a name mention) were not coded. Feature names (Room Diary, Safe Mode) were treated as feature descriptions, not module names. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser reads exist for this vendor. One more own page was read once with fetch-once: the multi-property blog (best-multi-property-hotel-pms), cited by 18 answers and the source of the Claude q10 wording; its Stayntouch cons line names a mobile-first tablet architecture, so C08 (tablets) moved from unverifiable to true. The same page lists Stayntouch as Bethesda, MD (2012) with a custom quote for chain plans, but no answer states the headquarters or founding year, so no claim was added. Gap lines were about the category or other vendors, or named no third-party product (integrates with most CRM and RMS platforms), and were not coded; one instance was added to C07 (q6 ChatGPT run 1, staff serve guests anywhere on the property). No answer has a comparison table with Stayntouch as a column header. No claim is wrong or stale, so the consistency check changed nothing.
